glosses: to power (to provide power for a mechanical or electronic device)
to supply (to provide someone or something with what is needed)
to strengthen, to fortify (to make a group strong or stronger; to add strength to a group; to increase the strength of a group by joining it)

examples.text: Zasiliłam konto telefoniczne i znowu mogę dzwonić.
Zasil mi nitkę, bo źle widzę.
